title: Level
description: One level. The folder name is the level id. A path like backgrounds/room.webp is inside this level. A path starting with / is from content/, for shared files: /shared/backgrounds/room.webp.

name.description: Label shown in tools. Defaults to the folder name.

startScene.description: Scene id opened when the level starts. Defaults to the first scene.

ambience.description: Looping background sound for the whole level. A scene can replace it with its own.

scenes.description: Scenes keyed by id. The id is used by startScene and by other files.

locks.description: Combination locks keyed by id. A trigger opens one with { "lock": "id" }. The wheels are kept when the player leaves. A solved lock never opens again, and the triggers that open it disappear.

name.description: Label shown in tools. Defaults to the scene id.

fit.description: width touches the left and right edges and crops the top and bottom. height touches the top and bottom and crops the sides. cover fills the screen and crops the overflow. contain shows the whole image with bars around it.

look.description: False holds the camera still. Menus use this so buttons do not slide.

background.description: Background image. Shared art uses /shared/backgrounds/room.webp. An animated WebP loops. Leave it out for a dark placeholder.

dialogue.description: Ink knot from content/story/story.ink, played when the scene opens, before onEnter.

ambience.description: Replaces the level ambience while this scene is open.

onEnter.description: Actions run when the scene opens, after dialogue.

triggers.description: Click boxes, in pixels of the background. A label draws a button. Without a label the box is invisible. The debug panel can draw every box.

texts.description: Lines of text, in pixels of the background. They are not clickable.

id.description: Name used in tools and error messages.

label.description: Drawn as a button. Leave it out for an invisible hotspot.

once.description: The trigger disappears after it runs. False keeps it clickable. Omitted means true.

x.description: Center of the rectangle, in pixels of the background.

y.description: Center of the rectangle, in pixels of the background.

actions.description: Run in order on click. sound does not wait. dialogue waits. go, level, and quit stop the list.

dialogue.description: Ink knot name from content/story/story.ink, such as intro.

go.description: Scene id in this same level.

level.description: Level folder name to open, such as level-1.

fullscreen.description: Switches between the window and the whole screen. The button label shows On or Off.

dev.description: Shows or hides the debug panel and the scene tools. Works in a published build.

shop.description: Opens the shop on the menu, where decor and maps can be bought.

focus.description: Black screen to pick a focus length, then a short monologue, then the first level. The length stays at one minute.

lock.description: Id of a lock in this level's locks. Opens its panel, then ends the list. A solved lock does nothing.

quit.description: Closes the window. If the browser keeps the tab, the player is asked to close it.

shake.description: true uses the default shake. An object can set intensity (pixels) and duration (milliseconds).

title.description: Line drawn at the top of the panel.

values.description: Values every wheel cycles through, in order. Text or numbers: [0, 1, 2] or ["A", "B", "C"].

combination.description: The value each wheel must show. Its length is the number of wheels. Every value must be in values.

start.description: Values shown the first time the panel opens, one per wheel. Defaults to the first value on every wheel.

panel.description: Backdrop image for the panel. Shared art uses /shared/ui/lock-panel.webp. Leave it out for a plain plate.

sounds.description: A sound left out uses the default in src/lock/LockConfig.ts. null keeps that moment silent.

solve.description: Every wheel matches. Plays over the last change.

close.description: The player left before solving it.

onSolved.description: Run in order once the solved panel has closed, like a trigger's actions.

x.description: Center of the line, in pixels of the background.

y.description: Center of the line, in pixels of the background.

image.description: Character image. Shared art uses /shared/characters/hana.webp. An animated WebP loops.

x.description: Center of the character, in pixels of the background image.

y.description: Center of the character, in pixels of the background image.

scale.description: Relative to the background. 1 keeps the image's own pixel size.
